mugs:
Use case: product-mockup. Create a premium industrial design approval sheet, landscape 3:2, high resolution. Seamless pure white background, eight isolated studio product renders arranged in an exact 2-row by 4-column grid with generous white margins, no labels or text. Every cell contains ONE ceramic mug and nothing else. Same precisely consistent contemporary 330 ml mug geometry in every view: straight cylindrical body slightly rounded at the bottom, thin but practical rim, comfortable simple rounded D-shaped handle, refined glazed porcelain, believable dimensions. No saucers, no rings, no orbit graphics, no rockets, no logos, no patterns, no geometric ornament.
TOP ROW colorway: warm white glossy exterior including handle, rich royal blue #0375DB glazed interior. BOTTOM ROW: rich royal blue #0375DB satin exterior including handle, warm white glossy interior. Columns, same exact camera angles for both rows: 1 straight front with handle on right and a tiny glimpse of the inside; 2 elevated three-quarter front revealing the interior; 3 rear three-quarter with handle on left; 4 true top-down view showing the circular opening and handle on right. All mugs sit naturally and are completely inside their cells without overlap. Very soft short contact shadows, neutral color-accurate high-key product photography, sharp realistic porcelain texture, restrained specular highlights, no dramatic lighting, no dark backdrop. These are Efeonce studio accessory concepts. Their brand presence is restrained material and color, intentionally clean surfaces. Images will be reused as product references, so consistency of physical shape between views is essential.
